content.title: About
content.content: Milk shake with malt is a refreshing beverage made from milk, ice cream, malt flavoring, and sometimes a splash of cream. The malt gives it a sweet, slightly caramel-like taste reminiscent of beer notes, but without any alcohol.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The malt used in the shake is derived from sprouted barley that is dried and roasted.
The first malt‑flavored milk shake appeared in the United States in the 1960s as a fast‑food menu item.
Malt aroma often evokes childhood memories of the Soviet‑era “milk bar” ice creams.
The shake can be served cold or warm by substituting hot milk for ice.
Malt extract contains small amounts of B‑vitamins retained from the grain.

items.title: Calcium source
items.content: The milk base provides calcium, essential for strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: Milk and ice cream supply a complete set of amino acids that support muscle recovery.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: Malt extract retains modest levels of vitamins B1, B2 and niacin, aiding energy metabolism.

items.title: Mood‑boosting
items.content: The sweet taste and malt aroma can stimulate serotonin production, helping improve mood.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: The shake often contains a lot of sugar, which can contribute to weight gain if consumed frequently.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: People with lactose intolerance should use lactose‑free milk or plant‑based alternatives.

items.title: Milk allergy
items.content: Allergy to milk or dairy proteins makes the shake unsuitable for some individuals.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Added ice cream and cream make the drink calorie‑dense; portion control is recommended.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the milk shake with malt in tall glasses, topped with whipped cream and a sprinkle of ground malt or cinnamon. It can be sipped through a straw or used as a sauce for desserts such as pancakes.

content.title: Storage
content.content: The shake is best enjoyed immediately. If you need to store it, keep it refrigerated in a sealed container for no more than 2‑3 hours to prevent cream separation.
